note: Reviewed CDB90 match 37, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: The municipal historical report dates the Battle of Turckheim to 5 January 1675 and names Turenne and Bournonville. Both complete source armies remain local, preserving IMP ALLIED ARMY as a combined field force. This approval does not convert a whole army strength estimate into a count of troops in an individual assault. Identity review (attacker; original CDB90 name FR ARMY): CDB FR ARMY / TURENNE corresponds to the French field army in the municipal account of the 5 January 1675 battle. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name IMP ALLIED ARMY): CDB IMP ALLIED ARMY is retained as one local combined force; the municipal report independently identifies Bournonville as its Imperial commander.
